violations.message: Checkout "checkout-1" forwards to "checkout-2" (type "checkout"). A Checkout takes payment, so it must forward to an upsell, downsell or thank-you page. If this page collects details and moves on without placing an order, type it "checkout_step".
A path from entry page "landing-1" reaches "upsell-1" (upsell) after passing more than one Checkout, so it takes payment twice.
